summary: Narrow successor of archived TELEMETRY-BINDING-READ-CAPACITY-20261011 (PR #6518, 5cef17cd -> e7a33a4e). Preserving genuine merged PR #6521 (commit be87b5a0a merged as 1f6eaf519 into dev), build_postgres_event_reader in services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py uses UNION ALL between mutually disjoint branches (b1 ∩ b2 = ∅), eliminating HashAggregate and Unique on the payload while preserving row identity, ordering, deterministic tie-breaking on ingested_seq DESC, and keeping cumulative net production lines at exactly 1 against baseline f5b8163fd7f333d116ec15176e73d019797e6bcc (budget <= 10). All 146 tests across 4 test suites pass. Evaluation against original production read-only PostgreSQL and EXPLAIN records the factual capacity counter: while UNION ALL eliminates HashAggregate and Unique on the payload, the query plan shows B1 child's BitmapIndexScan on idx_telemetry_events_binding_id estimates 186,546 index input rows, while subsequent BitmapHeapScan/Gather/Sort/Limit estimates 1 row after guard filter (not Sort on 186,546 output rows). Cause is NOT established and current capacity is NOT fixed; estimates and plans diagnose index scan behavior under existing indexes, but estimates/plans do not prove root cause or that index authority is required. No index, schema, timeout, or budget expansion is requested; source0 truth correction within original 3 paths is maintained and genuine merged PR #6521 is preserved.

cause_and_solution_proof.disjointness_proof: Branch 1 filter contains payload->>'binding_id' = $1 (requiring binding_id to match string parameter $1, hence non-null). Branch 2 filter contains payload->>'binding_id' IS NULL. Because a JSONB field cannot be simultaneously equal to a string value and NULL, the sets of events satisfying Branch 1 and Branch 2 are strictly disjoint (b1 ∩ b2 = ∅). Zero duplicate rows can exist between the two branches.

execution_plan_improvement.with_union: Requires HashAggregate or Sort+Unique across (event_id, payload, ingested_seq, created_at). Hashing and comparing full JSONB payloads introduces significant memory and CPU load, destroys subquery sort properties, and forces an outer Sort on created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC. Total estimated cost: 539,192.23.
execution_plan_improvement.with_union_all: Eliminates HashAggregate and Unique on payload. Top node executes Merge Append. However, B1 child's BitmapIndexScan on idx_telemetry_events_binding_id estimates 186,546 index input rows, while subsequent BitmapHeapScan/Gather/Sort/Limit estimates 1 row after guard filter (not Sort on 186,546 output rows). Child cost 539,183.69. Merge Append cannot stream in O(limit) time when child requires full index scan and sort under existing indexes. Total estimated cost: 539,192.20.
